title: ATF attempt to link guest to the Oklahoma City bombing
summary: Steve tells of ATF attempt to link guest to the Oklahoma City bombing, about about 1995 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: near as I can figure, the ATF was trying to punish me for not cooperating in their investigation by trying to link me to that that bombing.

plain: A scientist named Steve, who studies objects some people believe are alien implants in human bodies, says that around 1995 the ATF, the US federal agency that deals with firearms and explosives, tried to tie him to the Oklahoma City bombing carried out by Timothy McVeigh. As near as he can figure, he says, the agency was punishing him for refusing to cooperate with one of its investigations. He tells it as an example of government pressure on him.
